column3: web/e2e (Playwright) stays out of the required CI set, as it was under Actions
column4: On a clean Ubuntu 24.04 VM, 154 of 180 e2e tests fail with ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED: the harness's vite server listens on localhost (::1) and the tests dial 127.0.0.1. With the server bound to 127.0.0.1 most pass, but a few chunk-failure tests time out, and the whole suite takes several minutes in one process
column5: bun test e2e on a 4 vCPU VM: 26 pass and 154 fail before the change; with host 127.0.0.1, 58 pass before the 300 s cap
column6: open: fix the harness bind and the slow tests, then shard e2e onto the runners
